note: AGENTS.md is the one instruction file this repository maintains. Most coding agents read it directly and need nothing else. The rest each look for a file of their own, so each gets a pointer that says where the instructions actually are. A pointer holds no instructions itself, because two files holding the same rules drift and a reader then follows whichever they happened to open.
howItWasRead: The adopter list on agents.md names the agents that read AGENTS.md natively. Every path under pointer was taken from that tool's own documentation rather than from that list, because the list says which tools read AGENTS.md and never says what a tool that does not would read instead.
watchedBy: conformance/agents_support.py, weekly, which reports any adopter this record does not name

tools.name: GitHub Copilot
tools.note: The adopter list names Coding agent, which is the Copilot that runs a task on its own. The Copilot inside an editor is a different surface and reads this file, so the pointer stays.

readsAgentsFile.note: The adopter list on agents.md, name for name as the page prints them. It is kept verbatim so the weekly watcher can diff against it and report a name that appeared since. None of these needs a file here.
